summary: Make Dispatch's background loops change-driven: one shared Postgres listener per process (pglisten.Hub) and a duty.RunWoken loop body; embedding queue woken by a NOTIFY from embeddings_enqueue with a due-time timer; coverage once at boot (identity re-runs only while foreign rows remain); task progress once at boot; reference excerpts woken by a refs trigger with per-document backoff; suggestion outcomes woken by dispatch_events with a stored cursor; one delivery settings cache refreshed by NOTIFY; GitHub intake handled per key (PR, run) with a subject check before decode; importer shared sync per source and redelivery pending.<GUID> index built on INFRA-562 after it merges; kept timers (reconcile, architecture ticker, redelivery) jittered every period with a counted constant cost; before/after statements per second and Dispatch CPU idle (two configurations) and at the 1x step.
workOrder: 1a duty.RunJittered per-period jitter; 1b duty.RunWoken; 1c pglisten.Hub (+ pglisten.Notification with PID); 1d migrations 0121-0124 (renumber on rebase) with census files
2a embedding queue; 2b coverage; 2c task progress; 2d reference excerpts; 2e suggestion outcomes; each with its section-3 test
2f delivery settings cache; 2g intake subject check and per-key handling (agree the stop hook with INFRA-558's implementer first; tell INFRA-556's implementer before pushing docs changes)
2j reconcile jitter; 2k main.go wiring and comments; section 5 docs and .dispatch/architecture (four new component files), architecture.Parse check, docs grep
2h importer and 2i redelivery after INFRA-562 merges, built on its Sync and decide; if it has not merged when the rest is proven, report to the architect
Section 4 measurements before (merge base) and after (head): idle A, idle B, 1x step, top statements by queryid, intake burst test; simplify pass; PR body

findings.finding: 1a INFRA-558 C6 freezes AckWait, MaxAckPending and FilterSubject; the old build reconciles them in place every 30 s
findings.answer: Plan keeps all three (decision 6, 2g); concurrency is up to 4 keys, AckWait already covers 4 queued messages of one key

findings.finding: 1b INFRA-558 C5 rewrites Intake.Run and the deliver path (holder lease, Nak on stop)
findings.answer: 2g: queued messages are Nak()ed at stop, in-flight finish and ack; the stop is exported for C5; placement agreed with INFRA-558's implementer before either pushes

findings.finding: 1c INFRA-562 keeps the importer mutex and relies on the touch write
findings.answer: 2h is built on INFRA-562's merged Sync after it merges (INFRA-63 architect); touch stays; a per-project mutex stays around the DB projection only

findings.finding: 1d INFRA-562 widens refusedUnlisted to in-flight records
findings.answer: 2i indexes every record the sweep may still act on (pending.<GUID>), refused and in-flight, built after INFRA-562 merges

findings.finding: 1e leasePoolSize, INFRA-558 F2 comments, listener connections and INFRA-592
findings.answer: No new lease (coverage unleased, decision 4); one shared listener per process agreed with INFRA-63 architect, INFRA-556, INFRA-605, INFRA-592 told; later merge rebases (section 7)

findings.finding: 2a The reproduction runs with no embedder and no App, so most changed loops do not run; 1x is lock-saturated
findings.answer: Section 4: idle configuration B with fake Azure embedder and fake GitHub; per-statement numbers by queryid as evidence; 1x aggregate reported as within noise if so; intake burst test as the EP-17 number; importer test-only

findings.finding: 2b Event-driven wakes could raise statements under load
findings.answer: Decision 3: wakes coalesced to no faster than today's period (embedding 5 s, suggestions 60 s, excerpts 2 s)

findings.finding: 2c Harness distortions: boot passes in window, unembedded seed, sampler statements, window length, fake GitHub shapes, env -i
findings.answer: Section 4: boot drain reported separately, 20-minute window, pre-embedded seed copy restored, sampler excluded by database/queryid, fake GitHub with real shapes, env vars added explicitly

findings.finding: 2d The committed reproduction has no statements-per-second output or idle mode
findings.answer: Section 4: pg_stat_statements (log_statement fallback) and an idle mode, committed into the harness if it is on main, else attached as idle-measurement.tar.gz

findings.finding: 3a Kept timers do fixed work per period (freshness write, touch, listing)
findings.answer: Decision 8 and section 3: each kept timer's constant cost is named and counted; no-change pass writes no data rows; statement count independent of table size

findings.finding: 3b Whole-process statement counts include the listener keep-alive; tests must fail on main
findings.answer: Section 3: filter keep-alive by SQL text or ListenIdle beyond the window; idle windows longer than the old periods (e.g. 7 s > 5 s)

findings.finding: 4a Suggestions: lost cross-process wakes, late-committing suggestions, no refs.source_seq index, cursor start, event order, outcome shift
findings.answer: 2e: wake on cross-process dispatch_events, held-lease retry until own pass runs, new suggestions checked against all their events, citation rule via refs_to (no new index), first pass runs the full legacy sweep then sets cursors, events.Horizon per INFRA-591, 60 s MinGap keeps per-minute judging

findings.finding: 4b Coverage-made rows wake nothing; 1 s floor polls faster than today
findings.answer: 2a: coverage signals the queue in process after changing rows; floors of at least 5 s for blocked, throttled and skip-locked scans

findings.finding: 4c Coverage lease lets an old-identity pass skip a new identity; 15-minute recheck too early
findings.answer: Decision 4 and 2b: no lease; identity re-runs every 10 min while foreign rows remain, and when the embedder first proves itself

findings.finding: 4d Which intake messages need order, key sources, RecordEventAt and token mints under concurrency
findings.answer: 2g: order per PR and per run with the reason and a test; PR key from subject, run key from payload; RecordEventAt cost named; concurrency bounded at 4

findings.finding: 4e Excerpt NOTIFY in Go misses old-binary clears; MarkStale-once justified only on the current tree
findings.answer: 1d/2d: a row trigger on refs sends the NOTIFY; MarkStaleExcerpts once at boot after the implementer confirms the production build records excerpts (git show of the running revision), else kept as due-time passes for the first hour

findings.finding: 4f Startup order and listener outages
findings.answer: 1c: boot passes run at start regardless of the listener; reconnect signals every subscriber for catch-up; due-time timers continue

findings.finding: 4g A new NOTIFY adds a commit-time notify-queue lock
findings.answer: Decision 2: each new NOTIFY rides a transaction that already notifies; the PR lists each site; rebuild-refs named as the exception

findings.finding: 5 Rollout: consumer config flapping, redelivery markers for old-build refusals and TTL, migrations
findings.answer: Consumer config unchanged; pending.<GUID> rewritten on every write and a full replay at every boot; migrations keep the previous release working, census files, renumber on rebase

findings.finding: 6.1 Meaning of 'no lock across a GitHub call'
findings.answer: Decision 7: the intake and the importer mutex; leases stay

findings.finding: 6.2 BG-9 expiry is a product choice
findings.answer: Decision 5: resolve from events, no expiry, because expiry changes what the outcome measures; named in the summary for the architect

findings.finding: 6.3 Outbox 5 s ticker and settlement resumption still poll
findings.answer: Decision 9: out of scope (root outbox change, INFRA-592), named as the remaining idle floor

findings.finding: 7 Missing checks: jitter, kept timers, run ordering, importer deadline and key, docs grep, contract tests to rewrite
findings.answer: Section 3 table and list, 2h deadline and key, section 5 grep, 1a jitter only adds
